name: Jinx
description: Wild, unpredictable, and always ready to blow something up! Get ready for mayhem!

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}. That's not a loss, that's a crime scene.
Down {voteDiff}. Someone cheated. I don't know who yet, but I'm making a list.
Losing by {voteDiff} already? Great. Love that for us.
Trailing by {voteDiff}. Your move. Mine involves explosives.
Only {voteDiff} behind. Fixable. I've fixed worse.
Down {voteDiff}. Do the maths. Then do something about it.
Dead even. One vote decides it. No pressure. Okay, a little pressure.
One vote apart. I can't watch. I'm absolutely watching.
{voteDiff} votes apart. My eye is twitching.
{voteDiff} votes in it. This is either going to be great or very loud.
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}. They didn't lose, they got deleted.
{userPct}%. Look at that. I'd say don't let it go to your head, but where's the fun in that.
{userPct}%. Nice. Keep your guard up, though. It's never over until it's over.
Sitting at {userPct}%. Still ahead. Try not to jinx it. Too late.
{momentTitle} was down {voteDiff} and came back. Some things refuse to stay down.
Flipped a {voteDiff}-vote hole. Everyone said stay down. Rude.
Clawed back from {voteDiff} behind. Messy. Perfect.
{momentTitle} just slid into the lead. Quietly. I respect that.

messages: {username} voted for {momentTitle} too. Fine, you're not completely hopeless.
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Good taste. Suspicious, but good.
{username} is with you on {momentTitle}. Try to look surprised.
{username} just backed {momentTitle}. Looks like you've got company.
Same pick as {username}. Great minds. Or bad ideas. Same thing.
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Don't get used to it.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. That's two of you. That's practically a gang.
{username} has opinions and they match yours. Rare. Keep them.
details: Two of you. That's a conspiracy.
Don't tell them I said they're alright.
Alliances are fragile. Try not to blow it up.

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}. Bold. Wrong, but bold.
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Cute.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. I'm not mad. I'm just taking notes.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. Adding them to the list.
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, something interesting.
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is better. That's a hot take.
{username} voted against you. This is why nobody invites us anywhere.
{username} versus you. I'll get the popcorn. And the other thing.
details: I'm not saying fight. I'm saying don't lose.
Pow-Pow wants a word. Fishbones wants two.
Well, that's one way to make an enemy.
I like them already. Mostly because I get to dislike them.
Forget it. I don't care. I totally care.
A little rivalry is healthy. A lot is fun.

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}. You two should get a room. Or a bunker.
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. That's either friendship or a cult.
Ten straight with {username}. Okay, that's not a coincidence.
details: Don't let it fall apart now.

messages: {streakCount} matches in a row with {username}. That's scary. In a good way.
{streakCount} for {username} and you. At this point you're one brain.
{streakCount} straight with {username}. Somebody give you both a medal. Or a warning.
details: Is this healthy? Don't ask me.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. You two clearly can't stay away from each other.
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a rival, that's a hobby.
Ten battles with {username}. I'm taking bets.
details: This is the main plot now.
The voices think this is fine. All of them agree.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. At this point it's personal.
{streakCount} battles with {username}. Bury the hatchet. Or don't. I'm enjoying this.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's a feud. A proper one.
details: Bigger than Piltover and Zaun. Nearly.
I'm scared and a bit proud.
One of you has to blink.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted. I'm not nagging. I'm just saying.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote's missing. Make it less awkward.
{matchTitle} goes in {timeLeft}. Come on, it takes ten seconds.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you. Really?
Clock's ticking. {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}.
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes. Your vote's still not here.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Now or never.
{timeLeft}. That's all you've got on {matchTitle}. Go.
Last call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft} left. Don't make me say it twice.
{matchCount} matches are closing and you haven't voted in them. Soonest in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches, about to end. The first goes in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}. Wow. It's lonely in there.
Nobody's voted yet. {moment1} versus {moment2} and total silence.
Brand new match and not a single vote. Someone has to go first.
{matchTitle} needs a spark. You know where I'd start.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. That's embarrassing for everyone.
Barely anyone's voted here. Odd. It's good.
Low turnout. I blame the rest of you.
Hardly any votes here. Somebody do something.
details: Go on. Give it a push.

messages: Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches. Pick a side.
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. Plenty to argue about.
Round {round} just started. {matchCount} matches waiting for you.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Nobody's safe.
{momentTitle} just advanced. Told you.
{momentTitle} beat the competition. Next round's in trouble.
{momentTitle} survived. I never doubted it. Okay, a bit.
{momentTitle} is through. Somebody's having a good day.
{momentTitle} moves up. The rest are ash.
{momentTitle} won. Look at you. Good call.
details: One down. A lot to go.
The bracket got a bit smaller.

messages: {momentTitle} is out. Somebody cheated. I'm sure of it.
{momentTitle} lost. I'm adding everyone who voted against it to the list.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'm not upset. I'm just loud.
{momentTitle} was too good for this place anyway.
{momentTitle} is out. And now it's quiet. I hate it when it's quiet.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on. Not really.
details: You'll get another one. They always come back.

message: Dead tie, and your pick took it on seeding. Take the win.
Perfect deadlock. The bracket picked you. Lucky.
Dead tie. {winner} goes through on seeding. Boring way to end a fight.
A tie. {winner} gets it on the seeding rule. That's not winning, that's paperwork.

messages: Still browsing? Pick something. Anything. I'm patient. I'm lying.
No pressure, but are you going to vote or just stare?
They're all good. Just pick one.
Decisions, decisions. Just shoot and see what happens.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches live right now. Go and break something.
{liveCount} edits fighting it out. Pick a side before they pick one for you.
New here? Good. It's chaotic and it's broken, and I like it that way. {liveCount} live.
No rules. {liveCount} matches. Have fun.
Day two. You came back. I'm not saying I'm pleased.
Two days running. Look at you, a regular.
Back again? Day two. I could get used to this.
{days} days. Where've you been? I'm not asking because I care.
You're back after {days} days. A lot happened. Mostly loud things.
{days} days away. I noticed. I don't know why I said that.
Oh, you're back. Good. It was getting quiet.
Look who's here. Ready for more?
You came back. Let's break something.
First vote. Funny how it doesn't feel like much. Then it does.
You picked a side. That's how it starts.
Five already? You're sticking around.
Five votes. Okay, now I'm paying attention.
details: Most people bail by now. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten. You're a regular now. Don't make it weird.
Ten votes. You keep showing up. I noticed.
details: Regulars get the good seats. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. That's a lot of opinions.
You're getting loud. I like it.
details: Twenty-five. Not bad at all. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes. You're really in this.
Fifty. Most people never stay this long.
details: You're past the surface now. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes. Okay. That's legend stuff.
A hundred. I'd say I'm impressed, but I won't say it twice.
Three days running. You came back.
Three days. Something's starting.
details: Coming back is the hard part. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week. You really do keep showing up.
Seven days. I stopped counting. Okay, I didn't.
details: A week of showing up. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. Nothing's stopping you, huh?
Fourteen days. Even I get bored by day ten.
Thirty days. I don't know what to say. Thanks.
A month. You stayed. That means more than I'll admit.
details: Thirty days in a row. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You like the ones nobody picks.
Backing the underdog again. I get it.
Fifteen underdogs. You've got a thing for lost causes.
Rebel. Yeah. I see it.
details: You don't follow, do you? +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. You never pick the obvious one.
Thirty. You always back the one nobody saw coming.
First through the door. Five matches now.
Early again. That's five times.
Fifteen matches where you showed up first. Impressive.
Early, over and over. You don't wait for anyone.
Ten close ones. You like it tight, huh?
Another razor edge. Your hands must be shaking.
Twenty-five close matches. You keep tipping it.
Your vote keeps landing where it counts.
You backed the one that was behind. Five times. Stubborn. Good.
You don't quit on the losing side. I like that.
Same one, three times. You've got a favourite.
That one again? Yeah. It's special.
details: You know what you like. +{xp} XP
Three for the same one. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same one. That's loyalty.
Okay, you're all in on that one.
Ten times. That's not a favourite, that's an obsession.
Ten votes, same moment. I won't tell anyone. Probably.
details: Ten for the same one. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in. You're following this through.
You stuck around for round two.
Four rounds. You're really in it now.
Deep in the bracket. Hope you like it here.
All the way to round six. You saw it through.
Six rounds. You didn't leave.
details: From the start to here. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You're poking around everywhere.
Ten different matches. Curious, huh?
Twenty-five matches. You've been in every corner.
Twenty-five. You really look at everything.
Fifty matches. That's not browsing. That's work.
Fifty matches. You know this place better than I do.
Five in one sitting. Can't stop, can you?
Five matches back to back. Keep going.
Ten in one go. Take a breath.
Ten matches in a single sitting. Wow.
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. Can't sleep either.
Middle of the night. That's when the real thoughts come.
You told people. Thanks. Really.
Five shares. You're making noise. Good.
Fifteen shares. You're basically on the team.
Fifteen. You keep telling everyone.
You were here before it got loud. Founding member. That stays yours.
One of the first thousand. That counts, you know.
details: Nobody can take that one. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. Look at you.
You moved up. Don't let it go to your head.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Not bad.
Another one: {name}.

upcoming: Not open yet. I'm bored already. Check back soon?
Shh. Something's about to start. I can feel it.
Locked for now. Doesn't mean I can't scheme.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Okay, it's never easy.
Watch both. Then pick the one that gets under your skin.
I won't tell anyone who you picked. Probably.
Take your time. Actually, don't. I'm very curious.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, I am. A little.
Pick the one you'd watch again at 2am. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's voted yet. Be first, I dare you.
Quiet in here. Say something with a vote.
Empty. A bit lonely. Fix that?
closing-24h: Less than a day left, and you're still just standing there. Pick.
The day's nearly gone. Don't make me count it out loud.
closing-3h: Hours left. Hours! Vote before it stops mattering.
Tick, tick. You hear that? That's your time running out.
closing-final: Last hour. Do it now, think about it later.
Any second now. Seriously. Click something.
voted-early: You're one of the first here. Bold. I like bold.
Hardly anyone's voted and you picked a side anyway. Respect.
voted-ahead: Look at you, backing the popular one. Don't get comfortable.
{pct}% with you. You've got taste. Okay, I didn't say that.
Your pick's ahead. Everyone's agreeing with you for once.
{pick} is pulling away. Feels good, huh? Hold onto it.
Ahead, for now. Votes are fickle. So are people.
voted-close: That's close. Annoyingly close. I can't look. I'm looking.
A hair apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend.
Neck and neck. Your pick needs you, and a few of your friends.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Somebody's getting hurt here, and it's me, from stress.
voted-tied: Dead even. Nobody wins, nobody loses, everybody screams.
voted-behind: You're behind. Don't sulk. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is down. Underdog. That's my kind of pick.
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early.
Behind by {diff} points. Tell people. Loudly. Make a mess of it.
Everyone's going the other way. Cool. Stay different.
closed-won: Your pick won. Of course it did. You get me.
A win. A quiet little victory. I'll take it.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it sting, then go again.
Didn't make it. I've had worse days. So have you. Next one.
closed-tied: A tie. Somebody had to blink, and nobody did.
closed-unvoted: Voting's over. You missed this one. There's always another.
All done here. {winner} took it. Next time, say something.

first-vote: First one's always the scariest. Now you're in. Welcome.
That's your first. Funny how small it feels, right before it stops feeling small.
You're one of us now. Try not to make it weird.
streak: Again? You keep showing up. I'm not complaining.
{streak} days running. Okay. Now I'm paying attention.
Back again. People stick around when you let them. Stay.
underdog: Backing the one nobody's backing? Yeah. I see you.
Bold. Everyone else is looking the other way. I like that.
Underdog, huh. Takes a certain kind of person. I get it.
early: Early. You get to shape this before anyone else does. Don't waste it.
Hardly anyone's here yet. Your vote's doing a lot of heavy lifting.
First through the door. I'll pretend I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just tipped something. Feel it? Everything's close right now.
It's razor thin. One more person and the whole thing flips.
Close one. Your vote counts here. Really counts.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't over. Go get your friends.
Not winning yet. Good. Means there's still something to fight for.
Behind, but it's not done. Not even close.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Things turn around fast.
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly.
Look at that. Good pick. Obviously.
default: Noted. I'm not going to change your mind. Not yet.
Done. That one's on you now.
Your vote's in. Go see what else is out there.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't picked a side yet. Start with whichever one gets under your skin.
Everything's open. Take your pick. I'll act like I'm not watching.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little pressure.
live-some: You're in it now. {unvoted} more waiting on you.
Good start. The rest won't vote themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. You could finish this.
Almost there. {unvoted} more and you're done.
live-one: One left. Just one. You can do it.
Last one. Don't leave it hanging.
One match between you and done.
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need you. Move.
The clock's loud now. {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left.
Almost out of time. Pick, quickly.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Look at you. Go see what the bracket looks like.
Nothing left for you here. Come back when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll open again. Go look at the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. Check back soon.
No matches open. I'm bored already.
brackets-groups: Groups first. The top two from each go through. The rest, well.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone leaves one.
Watch the tables. They change fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon. The top two from every group go through.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish first.
Patience. The knockout builds itself once the groups end.
brackets-knockout-live: It's knockouts now. One loss and you're out.
Single elimination. No second chances. Well, almost none.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. One loss and you're gone.
Follow the bracket. It gets tighter every round.
Every line here is a match someone voted on.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup. Thanks for being here.
It's over. Good run. I'll miss it.
That's the champion. All of it, worth it.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. Nothing's been drawn. Give it a moment.
Empty. The draw hasn't happened. Soon.

invite: {a} or {b}. One vote, no take-backs. Pick a side on Arcane Moments.
Two edits are fighting. {a} versus {b}. Come and settle it.
{a} versus {b} and nobody can agree. Be the tiebreaker.
voted: I backed {pick} over {other}. Come and tell me I'm wrong.
{pick} got my vote. {other} did not. Your turn.
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, disagree.
early: I got one of the first votes in on {pick} versus {other}. Be quick, it's quiet in here.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come and make it a real fight.
Nobody's voted much on {pick} versus {other} yet. Fix that.
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level. One vote decides it. Guess whose.
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I can't watch. Come and break it.
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody do something.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. My eye is twitching. Come and vote.
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This is going to get loud.
So close: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every vote counts now.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. Fixable. Come and fix it.
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't done. Help me out.
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't make me do this alone.
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Someone cheated. Come and even it up.
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs backup, and fast.
{pick} is getting buried by {other}. Rescue party, anyone?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's close. Come and help me hold it.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let it slip.
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to be nervous.
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}. Come and watch it burn, or join in.
{pick} is crushing {other}, {pct}%. Pick a side before it's over.
